# SYNTHETIC AUTH-LEDGER transaction demonstration: transcript

**SYNTHETIC.** Generated by `tools/synthetic_transaction_demo.py`. Every decision and review record shown here was written by the script into a temporary repository that was deleted after the run. Nothing here is an owner decision, an approval, a review or a legal opinion. The real ledger was only read and stays at version 0.

- Real ledger HEAD before the run: `0 443c4bdf348b2a1bcd603d2701f097aa90a8155efd43c10760f5fd86c76c6b6b`
- Real ledger HEAD after the run: `0 443c4bdf348b2a1bcd603d2701f097aa90a8155efd43c10760f5fd86c76c6b6b`
- Commands are run from the temporary repository top (`$WORK/repo`, or `$WORK/negN` for negative cases) with the real AUTH-LEDGER command-line tool invoked by its absolute path.
- Deterministic: fixed identities and git dates; `--check` re-runs and compares every recorded value with `expected_hashes.json` and this transcript byte-for-byte.
